# Dynamis

**See everything. Prove anything.**

Simulator-agnostic verification intelligence for SystemVerilog/UVM.
One DPI-C recording layer runs on Verilator, VCS, and Xcelium
unchanged — one portable transaction database, one interactive viewer,
one regression gate.

We know exactly what a transaction is, because we implemented the
event scheduler underneath it.

→ **[dynamis-eda/dynamis](https://github.com/dynamis-eda/dynamis)**
